definitions.explanation: Devices and equipment that operate using electronic circuits. A general term covering computers, smartphones, tablets, and similar devices.

examples.japanese: {電子機器|でんしきき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
examples.english: Bringing in electronic devices is prohibited.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{離着陸時|りちゃくりくじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電子機器|でんしきき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please turn off your electronic devices during takeoff and landing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電子機器|でんしきき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}いこなせる→使いこなす：07179_tsukaikonasu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to learn to use the latest electronic devices.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧ (electronic) + ⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧ (equipment, devices). ⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧ itself is ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine) + {器|き} (instrument).

USAGE:
A general term that covers a wide range of electronic devices. Common in announcements, signs, and formal writing. In everyday conversation, people are more likely to name specific devices (⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧, ⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧, etc.).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {電子機器|でんしきき}: electronic device (general)
- ⟦{電化製品|でんかせいひん}→電化製品：04906_denkaseihin⟧: electrical appliance (household)
- ⟦{端末|たんまつ}→端末：05627_tanmatsu⟧: terminal, device (often for phones/computers)
- {精密機器|せいみつきき}: precision equipment
